data.name: Nasayir
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root s-y-r, meaning 'to win, conquer, or be victorious.' The name Nasayir symbolizes triumph over adversity and the strength to overcome challenges. In Islamic history, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) used this name for a companion who was a brave warrior and a trusted friend.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual victory of the heart over the lower self.
